items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I used to play over there with him, you see.

ctx.x: I never knew him. No. I heard him.

His daddy was named Agnes Oce, well, he had a band. I used to play with him. Some little bot had a band over there. I used to play with him. Then, uh, Agnes's, uh, brother-in-law, Giger, he used to get band jobs over there, and I used to play over there with him, you see.
